author: eliza
_note: THREE BEATS IN ONE POI, and it exists to prove the created beat slot rather than to be a good
mission. Beat two is an EXTRA: a marker alias, an activator, a stage and a stock hook, all
created by the generator rather than present on the base.
⚠ THE PROSE IS A PLACEHOLDER AND IS MINE, NOT JESSICA'S. Her testcase's middle beats are an
ABSENCE and a RECOVERY, and an extra slot as built is an activation like any other, so it
cannot stage an absence. Beat two below is the nearest honest thing an activation can be: the
load's own paperwork, found on the way. When she writes the real middle this recipe is the
shape it goes into, and the words are one edit.
⛔ An extra beat carries a JOURNAL and no objective, because the driver displays objectives 10
and 20 and nothing else. The lint refuses an objective here rather than writing a string no

prose.name: Never Arrived at the <Place>: <Planet>
prose.briefing: A load was signed out for the <Place> and never signed in. Nobody has been out to look for it. Find where it stopped.

beats.journal: Signed out, never signed in, and it got this far.
The manifest was still with it. Two halves, one signature, and only one of them ever moved.
